title: v1 End-to-End Factor Research Workflow (年化 12% / Sharpe 1.2 / MDD 12% target)

Stage_2_regime_classifier.name: Daily Regime Classifier
Stage_2_regime_classifier.method: LightGBM classifier predicts bull/bear/sideways per day
Stage_2_regime_classifier.note: 已有 evidence，但需要重新校准 target（不是 3-class，bull_composite 跑 22 年全期）

Stage_3_multi_symbol_composite.name: Multi-Symbol Regime-Specific Composite + Top-K
Stage_3_multi_symbol_composite.method:
Use bull_composite pipeline. Per regime:
- bull: 6 因子 composite (talib_NATR/TRANGE + gtja_159/149/144 + mw_vol_20d) × top-K=20
- bear: reversal/morphology (KD<20 + vol_shrink + hammer + morning_star) × top-K=15
- sideways: 空仓 / 防御 (no signal)
per-regime closed_only_return + sharpe + MDD + commission
Stage_3_multi_symbol_composite.estimated_backtests: bull: 10 legs, bear: 10 legs, sideways: 5 windows

Stage_4_regime_router.name: Regime Router + Composite Selection
Stage_4_regime_router.method:
Daily router using LightGBM classifier output:
- bull router -> bull_composite top-K
- bear router -> bear reversal
- sideways router -> cash
Cost: 25bps commission + 10bps slippage per side

Stage_5_oos_validation.name: OOS Validation + Cost Sensitivity + Kill-Switch
Stage_5_oos_validation.method:
Time-series split:
- train 2010-01 ~ 2018-12 (8y)
- val 2019-01 ~ 2021-12 (3y, COVID + bull recovery)
- OOS 2022-01 ~ 2025-12 (4y, recent regime mix)
Cost sensitivity: commission={0,15,25,40} × slippage={0,5,10}
Kill-switch: if MDD > 8% -> flat for 20 days

single_variable_discipline.rule: Each Stage changes ONLY ONE variable from prior Stage. No multi-variable tuning.
single_variable_discipline.rollback: Stage N+1 failure → revert to Stage N artefacts + adjust Stage N+1 contract.
single_variable_discipline.frozen_code: panel_loader.py is FROZEN. Stage 3+ only ADD new scripts.
